toggle.label: Enroll as a package
toggle.hint: Charge these courses together: one discount on the total, one installment schedule, one payment at admission and one admission receipt.

discount.heading: Package discount
discount.splitLabel: Split the discount over the installments
discount.byFee: Each course's share of the discount is in proportion to its fee.

schedule.heading: Package installments
schedule.hint: Each installment is split across the courses in proportion to their fees; each course gets its own matching installments.

payment.heading: Payment at admission
payment.receiptHint: One admission receipt lists every course in the package.

errors.blocked: Some courses cannot be part of a package (see above).
errors.paymentAmount: Enter the amount paid at admission.
errors.paymentTooMuch: The payment is more than the package total ({{net}}).

preview.heading: Admission package
preview.receipt: One admission receipt will list all these courses.

pay.heading: Package payment
pay.note: Settles the package installments earliest first; a part-payment is shared between the courses by what each owes.
pay.tooMuch: More than is still owed on the package ({{amount}}).
pay.previewError: Could not work out the split.

item.coversEarlier_one: Includes {{count}} earlier installment still open: payments clear the oldest first. Shared between the courses by what each owes.
item.coversEarlier_other: Includes {{count}} earlier installments still open: payments clear the oldest first. Shared between the courses by what each owes.

change.moveHint: Moves this installment on every course in the package.
change.splitHeading: Move part of the {{amount}} unpaid to a later date
change.splitHint: Shared between the courses by what each owes on this installment. The package total does not change.
change.newAmountError: Enter an amount of at least {{amount}} (already paid)
change.amountSuccess: Installment set to {{amount}} on every course
change.amountHint: Changes this installment on every course: each keeps what it has paid ({{paid}}) and the rest is shared by what each owes. The package total changes by the difference.
